book_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for morning/evening. On Day 23, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 10:58 (morning) but at bed_b1 at 22:53 (late night). The location is highly variable. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00) queries. For late night (22:00+), check bed_b1 first, as it appears to be returned to the bedroom at the end of the day. Do not assume coffee_table_l1 for late night.

mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested checking both kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1 for morning. On Day 23, it was at kitchen_table_k1 at 08:06. This confirms the inconsistency in the 08:00-12:00 window. Continue checking both kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1 for morning queries. Keep checking coffee_table_l1 for late night (22:00+).

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for mid-day. On Day 23, it was at dining_table_d1 at 19:52 (early evening). The "mid-day" pattern of coffee_table_l1 is unreliable for later hours. Check dining_table_d1 for early evening (18:00-21:00) queries. Keep checking coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00) and sink_k1 for late night (22:00+).

charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night and coffee_table_l1 for morning. No new evidence today to contradict this. Continue checking coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00) and nightstand_b1 for late night (22:00+).

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night. No new evidence today to contradict this. Continue checking nightstand_b1 for late night (22:00+) queries.
